insurer_name: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
residency_requirement: Indian resident; allopathic and AYUSH treatments in India only
sub_limits_waiting_notes: PED 36 months; specific waiting up to 36 months

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Covered up to Sum Insured; no room rent capping

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All day care + Modern Treatments up to SI

domiciliary_treatment.limit_text: Home Care covered up to Sum Insured

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Road ambulance up to Sum Insured; Air ambulance up to Rs 2,50,000 per hospitalisation

restoration_benefit.limit_text: ReAssure+ Forever: unlimited Sum Insured refills triggered by first paid claim; max per claim = Base SI

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Annual checkup from day 1 via app

notable_exclusions_summary: ReAssure 2.0 = unlimited Sum Insured refill (ReAssure+ Forever) once triggered. Lock the Clock locks premium age until first claim. Booster+ carry-forwards unused SI. No room rent cap. AYUSH and allopathic limited to India.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via Niva Bupa network with 30-minute pre-auth target. Reimbursement via app for non-network providers within 48 hrs of admission.
